reply:
`rem` units are relative to the root element (html), not the parent. `em` is relative to the parent.

So with your 2rem on the nested element: if your html has the default 16px, then 2rem = 32px always, regardless of what the parent font-size is. That's why it's much bigger than you expected—you likely wanted `em` instead.

If the parent was 14px and you'd used `2em`, you'd get 28px. With `2rem`, you get 32px.
